details: The zoom handler calls draw() directly on every mousemove event with no RAF coalescing — notably, pendingTransform/rafId variables and a debouncedZoom object are declared (lines 524-529) but never wired up, leaving the actual handler unthrottled; this causes DOM mutations on axes on every frame. All other patterns are sound: transform.rescaleX(xScale) is used correctly on the original scale, there are no D3 transitions to interrupt, and single-view architecture eliminates loop risk.
